text.tspan: Learning adjusted years of schooling in girls and boys 2010
Learning-adjusted years of schooling merge the quantity and quality of education into one metric, accounting
for the fact that similar durations of schooling can yield different learning outcomes.

tspan.tspan: World Bank based on methodology in Filmer et al. (2018)
Where data for 2010 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2011 and 2020 is shown instead.
